summary: A parent, Anna, has moved to Finland from England and is seeking full-time daycare options for their three-year-old daughter due to balancing a full-time job. They are unfamiliar with the local system and asked for clarification on different daycare types available in Espoo, including municipal, private, family, day care, open playground, and playground groups. The advisor, Susan, explained the options and confirmed the need for full-time care. The conversation highlights the parent's situation and the initial discussion on available daycare services. Next steps include providing detailed information on each option and assisting with the application process.

questionnaire.Contents of the customer visit: Family life (eg.: children's school, early childhood education, relationships)
questionnaire.Any Additional Information: The customer mentioned they are balancing a full-time job with caring for their three-year-old daughter and are seeking daycare options in Finland, specifically inquiring about meal provisions, application processes, and the possibility of remote assistance with forms. They also expressed concerns about the child adapting to the language in daycare and the potential need to attend a faraway facility temporarily.
